answer: Split every verdict across 3 independent auditors and weight each vouch by reciprocity, so a cluster that only vouches inward scores zero. Budget it in hours: one honest task costs 2 hours, while a farm account needs 3 auditors, 3 vouches and a re-check, 6 hours before its first payout. Every vouch is re-checked on a 30-day pulse, so a bought auditor must be re-bought. The cheapest attack costs 3x honest work; that is the line, and a tide of fake accounts does not lower it, however deep the karst.
